hypothesis_title: STR_1701_V2 Confidence-Aware Linear Tilt — RF-A1 sub_stab 직접 해소
hypothesis_description:
Iter 11 STR_1701 (PG2 active 80%, SR 1.291 standalone / SR 1.4625 AB blend) 보강 — Confidence-aware per-name sizing.

## 동기 (PG2 incremental 보강)
- 2026-04-26 STR_1701 PG2 promotion 후 SR gap 0.5375 잔존 (목표 SR 2.0).
- Iter 11 R2 finalize G2 미해결: RF-A1 sub_stab 0.060 (M05 baseline 대비 적정한 수준이지만 ex-post override only).
- Iter 11 본질 강점: 5/5 Harvey + DSR 4.83 + Lockbox SR 1.89 + SR/CAGR/MDD all dominant
- 본 sprint 핵심: alpha source 단일성을 confidence-aware sizing으로 ex-ante 보강.

## 핵심 가설
- Linear Tilt 가중: w_i ∝ rank(score_i)^λ × confidence_i^κ (κ > 0)
- λ_i = λ_base × c_i (per-name confidence multiplier)
- c_i ∈ [0, 1]: 종목별 alpha forecast confidence (높을수록 weight 강화)
- 기대 효과: low-confidence name underweight → variance 감소 + sub_stab 강화 + MDD 완화

## Confidence vector 정의 후보 (Alpha 자율 선택)
1. Bootstrap-based: per-name alpha bootstrap CI, narrow CI = high confidence
2. Cross-validation residual: walk-forward residual std, low residual = high confidence
3. Sub-stability weighted: per-name sub-period IC consistency
4. ML uncertainty: XGB model leaf variance 또는 ensemble disagreement
5. 정보 이론: per-name signal-to-noise ratio

## 핵심 mandate (Iter 14 = Iter 11 V2)
- **STR_1701 multi-sleeve alpha base 그대로 사용 (변경 X)**
- Linear Tilt + Confidence-aware sizing 추가
- 평가: PG2 blended (V2 80% + STR_1656 20%) realized SR > **1.4625 baseline**
- sub_stab gate **≥ 0.50** mandatory (RF-A1 직접 해소)
- AB scenario 직접 NAV backtest (linear approximation 금지)

## Iter 13 학습 누적 (절대 금지)
- Universe enforce BEFORE training (panel 단계 — KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150)
- AvgTV20 = Close × Vol (NOT Size)
- Liquidity 2e8 KRW production (NOT 5e7 override)
- Codex resolution 9/9 mandatory (no silent omission)
- NW-HAC Harvey + 5-spec (NOT simple t-stat)
- 합리화 phrase 금지

## Common Charter 8원칙
- PIT only (C1~C15)
- QEPM 5단계
- Factor Family vs Proxy 구분
- 논문 출발점 (Black-Litterman / Lopez de Prado uncertainty / Avramov 2023)
- Data Mining 방지 (Harvey + DSR multi-test)
- Dynamic Smart Alpha (regime conditional)
- 비용 · 용량 · 군집
- No Silent Override

- RF-A1 sub_stab: STR_1701 0.060 → **V2 ≥ 0.50** mandatory (graduation gate)
- RF-A2 composite 개선 명확화

- RF-Turnover ≤ 600% (confidence-aware 적용 시 turnover 변화 측정)

- expected_role: core_with_alpha_amplification + confidence_aware_sizing
- why_now: STR_1701 PG2 promotion 직후 SR gap 0.5375. Single alpha source의 RF-A1 ex-post override 우려를 ex-ante confidence-weighted sizing으로 해소 + +0.05~0.10 SR 추가 기대.
